Title: Coastal distance of retreat
Description: Measures the annual horizontal landward movement of coastlines, reflecting shoreline erosion rates and long?term coastal change.

Title: Surface lowering
Description: Captures the vertical reduction of land surface elevation in millimetres, useful for monitoring erosion, subsidence, or sediment removal processes.

Title: Lost sediment mass
Description: Represents the amount of sediment removed from a given area, enabling assessment of soil erosion severity and land degradation.

Title: Hazard Index
Description: Index describing the level or classification of a hazard or multiple hazards.

Title: Event Frequency - Count per Year
Description: Number of events in a year
